summary: Frontend-only testing of Candice Ferragamo static site (age gate, hidden Backstage admin, WYSIWYG edit, media swap, country block, settings, export). All 13 scenarios pass. Site served by node static shim at REACT_APP preview URL; no backend.

test_results.age_gate_visible_and_dismissable: PASS - 'You must be 18+' overlay shown, 'I AM 18+ · ENTER' click reveals site
test_results.backstage_hash_trigger: PASS - #backstage in URL + reload opens admin login modal after ~400ms
test_results.keyboard_shortcut: PASS - Ctrl+Shift+K opens admin login (or panel if session valid)
test_results.edit_mode_toggle_and_save: PASS - body gains 'edit-mode', [data-edit] elements become contentEditable, blur triggers save to localStorage.candice_content, 'Saved' toast
test_results.edit_persistence_across_reload: PASS - edited hero span text ('TEST_EDIT_XYZ') persists after page reload
test_results.media_image_swap_via_url: PASS - gallery tile Change photo -> URL tab -> picsum URL saves, img.injected-media appears, localStorage.candice_media updated
test_results.media_video_swap_via_url: PASS - .video-frame Change video -> URL -> mp4 URL saves, video.injected-media appears
test_results.media_remove: PASS - REMOVE MEDIA button removes injected-media node from tile and clears entry from candice_media store
test_results.country_block_add: PASS - COUNTRIES tab, search 'India', click row -> localStorage.candice_blocked_countries contains 'IN', counter '1 country blocked'
test_results.country_block_toggle_off: PASS - re-click row removes IN from blocklist
test_results.password_change: PASS - Settings tab, updates candice_admin_pass in localStorage
test_results.logout_and_reprompt: PASS - btnLogout clears sessionStorage.candice_admin_session and hides panel; subsequent #backstage prompts for password again
test_results.export_download: PASS - #btnExport triggers download of 'index.html' (~98KB), content contains 'CANDICE — BACKSTAGE ADMIN' comment, 'candice_admin_pass' key, admin.js/admin.css inlined as <script>/<style>, and no <link href="admin.css"> or <script src="admin.js"> external references

critical_code_review_comments: admin.js is ~615 lines in a single file — acceptable for this static-site use case but could be split (bootstrap/media/countries/export) for maintainability.
resetContent()/resetMedia() rely on window.confirm which blocks headless test runs; not tested here — main agent may want to gate behind test-friendly handler.
openMediaPicker() clears #mediaFile.value but not #mediaUrl until UPLOAD tab set; fine, but if user opens picker for a fresh slot right after a URL save the URL input is cleared correctly. OK.
enforceGeoBlock silently swallows ipapi.co errors — good for reliability.
Export inlines admin.js/admin.css via fetch('admin.css') / fetch('admin.js') using relative URLs — will fail if the exported page is later re-exported from a different path. Not a current bug.
No data-testid attributes as noted in request; existing IDs sufficient for testing.
seed_data_creation: None — localStorage cleared at end of test run
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin flows verified end-to-end using Playwright on preview URL. Key gotchas: (1) #backstage hash is consumed on load via history.replaceState — use location.hash='#backstage'; page.reload() rather than page.goto(url+'#backstage') on same origin (goto skips reload when only hash differs). (2) Age gate must be passed after every fresh reload. (3) btnLogout is inside SETTINGS section (display:none until tab switched) — click .admin-tab[data-tab='settings'] first. (4) Ctrl+Shift+K opens admin panel directly (not login) when sessionStorage.candice_admin_session=='1'. (5) Export test: don't substring-match for src="admin.js" — those strings appear inside the inlined JS body itself; check for actual <script src=... > tag shape via regex.
